text:
mina (Design): quick UX nit — the confirmation toast after stopping a Dedicated pool says `Stopped` with only an Undo link. Users asked for clearer verb tense and a short hint about billing. current: `Stopped. Undo`
ryan (Eng): agreed. Toasts are short but we should avoid ambiguous past-tense single words. Also keep toast small for mobile.
sophie (PM): goals: 1) clarity (what happened), 2) next actionable step if it impacts billing, 3) keep to ~40 chars.
ara (A11y): toasts should be announced by SRs as status messages. prefer complete short sentence like `Dedicated pool stopped` rather than `Stopped`. also ensure `Undo` has `aria-label="Undo stop of pool {poolName}"`.
localize-bot: note: keep tokens separate — poolName should be a token. avoid contractions for some locales.
mina (Design): proposing three compact options:
1) "Dedicated pool stopped. Undo"
2) "Pool stopped — billing continues until end of hour. Undo"
3) "Stopped Dedicated pool. View billing • Undo"
ryan (Eng): 1 is simple. 2 might be too long for small viewports. 3 adds a link, would need an additional route. Prefer 1 and add a secondary small tooltip elsewhere about billing.
sophie (PM): +1 to 1. but we should add a separate small banner in the Pools page for billing details (non-blocking).
ara (A11y): final tweak for SRs: make toast text `Dedicated pool stopped.` (with period) then have buttons: `Undo` and `View pool` (if we show link). aria-live should be polite.
mina (Design): locking copy: toast text = `Dedicated pool stopped.` primary action = `Undo` (aria-label: `Undo stop of pool {poolName}`) secondary link (optional) = `View pool`. i'll update the component tokens and add translator notes.
ryan (Eng): will implement with maxWidth 360px and ensure the toast doesn't truncate the period. adding tests for SR announcement.
sophie (PM): adding to release notes: clearer toast copy for stopping Dedicated pools. thanks all :sparkles:
